title: Ask Atlas to generate a Grafana dashboard
description:
Type one sentence to Atlas, the AI analytics assistant in VirtualPyTest. It queries your test data and draws a canvas with pass rate, duration trend and incidents for the device you selected. One click opens the same panels as a real Grafana dashboard that you can edit, keep or share.

Open source & free.
